name: whatsapp-promotion-platform
description: End-to-end WhatsApp promotion platform: registration, consent, receipt validation, entry ledger, auditable draws, winners, claims and CRM synchronisation (spec rev 2026-09-07).

scripts.web:build: cd src/web-console && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && rm -rf ../web-console-dist && cp -R dist ../web-console-dist
scripts.check: node --version >/dev/null && for f in $(find src scripts test bench -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.js' 2>/dev/null); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'check ok'
